# Context:
#   Device    : Holiday ShowHome "LED Ball" (also snowflakes/icicles/tree/rope)
#   App       : Holiday ShowHome / "Show App" (iOS)
#   Password  : 123456   (throwaway, set in the app on all balls for this capture)
#   Command   : the user tapped ONLY "Red" (all lights) repeatedly during capture
#   Captured  : passively, via Home Assistant ESPHome Bluetooth proxies (advertisements)
#
# Each line is the raw 0xFEF1 service-data payload (hex) = on-air CSRmesh PDU.
# Layout (believed): seq[3 LE]  src[2 LE]  ciphertext  mic[8]  ttl[1]
#   src=0080 -> controller/app (0x8000); other src = a light relaying.
#   Same seq reappears with ttl byte cycling fc/fd/fe (rebroadcast counter, outside the MIC).

# GOAL: recover the key derivation from the password so these can be decrypted/forged.
# Standard CSRmesh key = reversed(SHA256(passphrase + b"\x00MCP"))[:16] does NOT work here
# (produces noise on these single-command packets), so the app transforms the password.
